results.query: What is the role of the Director of Quality ASSURANCE and CHANGE MANAGEMENT?
results.answer: The Director of Quality Assurance and Change Management takes charge of the quality assurance program, process of accreditation, and institutional planning procedures. They provide advice and guidance to college staff concerning the implementation of a quality management system, serve as a liaison between the college and accreditation agencies to facilitate the process, act as self-survey executive in charge of the operation of the various committees that make up the self-survey team, and ensure that quality processes and procedures serve the institution’s purposes, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and processes. (Source: Campus documents, Director of Quality Assurance and Change Management section)
